atoms.b:
Kitten Rescued from Tree
This last ((Sunday)) afternoon was quite an exciting one for the usually sleepy town of ((Sevenoaks)). A small, cuddly kitten was stuck in a tree in ((Hollybush_Park)) just off of ((Holmesdale_Road)). Local firefighters were called to the rescue, and they used their ladder to bring the kitten safely to the ground. A kind onlooker brought the kitten to the ((Second_Chance_Animal_Shelter)) where it was well taken care of.
